title: AW27 Women's Trim Stories
summary: Trims for each AW27 women's theme.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- APLF trims include patinated brass buckles, hammered studs, horn closures, magnetic closures, invisible zips, jewelled buckles, decorative chains, oversized resin buckles and rubberised webbing<sup>[1]</sup>
- Milano Unica trims: horn, corozo, mother-of-pearl and bio-based polyester buttons, oxidised metal pulls, chains and recycled leather labels<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Dramatic Presence
sections.body: Jewelled buttons, ruffles, lace, matte gold.

sections.heading: Soft Armour
sections.body: Concealed zips, magnetic closures, bonded seams.
